description.value: Lepp's Bakehouse is a family-owned bakehouse and delicatessen in downtown Abbotsford specializing in handcrafted sourdough bread, fresh-made sandwiches, and baked goods produced in-house using local ingredients wherever possible. The cozy café has ample seating and free Wi-Fi, making it a welcoming spot to rest and recharge. A second location in Fort Langley is slated to open summer 2026.

address.value: 2518 West Railway Street, Abbotsford, BC V2S 2E4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the phone number (604.851.5377) and street address (2518 West Railway Street) matching OSM. Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed by the website ('free wifi for guests too!'); no other cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned.
